reason: I'd maybe poke at the trial, but I wouldn't count on paying. There are no results or case studies, and $147 a month is a lot when I make under $5k a month. I'd rather spend that on ads.
objection: Nobody has shown it books a single call. 7 of 100 seats taken and no results published means I'd be the guinea pig at $147 a month. The trial is only 3 days, so I couldn't even see replies, and the card is required. If I forget to cancel, payments are final.
would_change_my_mind: Real screenshots or a case study of someone my size booking calls from it. A longer trial or a money-back guarantee would also help, or a price under $100.
